title: Flavor matrix default runner lives in get_runs_on and has no executable test guarding it
answers: Where is the default runner for generated flavor matrix jobs set?
Why would flavor test jobs run on the wrong runner after a runner change?
How do I change the default runs-on for dynamically generated flavor jobs?
body:
Invariant: the default runner for dynamically generated flavor matrix jobs is the fallback string in dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py:get_runs_on, passed to `_get_spec_value` when no version-specific `runs_on` is configured.
Changing that fallback changes every generated flavor job that does not override runner per version.
Review on this PR noted that dev/flavors/tests/test_matrix.py is globally skipped, so no unskipped test asserts the default or the version-specific override.
Fix pattern: when changing the default, add an unskipped unit test that asserts the default value and that configured version-specific `runs_on` values win.
Constraints: the pin in this PR was made without such a test; treat the test as a requested follow-up, not an existing guard.
applies: Flavor matrix generation in dev/flavors; does not cover hand-written runs-on values in .github/workflows/master.yml.
says: Automated flavor test jobs are executing on the wrong runner after our recent change.
Flavor matrix tests in the build pipeline should use the updated default test machine.
Change the default execution runner assigned to dynamically generated flavor test runs.
Generated flavor tests failed to switch to the new machine across unpinned versions.
The test matrix pipeline is missing checks to confirm the default runner assignment.
